items.title: 11.3 Reaction mechanism aur bond tootne ke tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.3 with Figures 11.5 and 11.6, printed pages 251-252.

blocks.title: Reaction mechanism
blocks.text: Reaction mechanism un qadmon ka silsila hai jo kul reaction ke doran hote hain. Sab kimiyai reactions ki tarah organic reactions mein kimiyai bonds toot-te hain, aur covalent bonds do tarah se toot sakte hain.

Homolytic fission tab hoti hai jab covalent bond barabar toot kar free radicals paida kare (Figure 11.5). Free radical woh species hai jis mein ghair-jora (unpaired) electron ho aur jo bohat reactive hai, kyunke unpaired electrons jora banane ka rujhan rakhte hain. Heterolytic fission tab hoti hai jab covalent bond is tarah toote ke asal mushtarka electron pair sirf ek atom ko mile, aur mukhalif charge wale ions paida hon (Figure 11.6); yeh bond fission mechanisms mein poore khamdar (curly) teeron se dikhai jati hai.

blocks.alt: Do reactions. A-B is tarah tootta hai ke har atom bond ke do electrons mein se aik rakhta hai, do fish-hook teeron se dikhaya, aur free radicals A dot aur B dot bante hain. Roshni (hv) mein Cl-Cl isi tarah do chlorine free radicals mein tootta hai.
blocks.caption: Homolytic fission aur free radicals ka banna (Figure 11.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Do reactions. Mura teer A-B ka bonding joray B ki taraf le jata hai, ions A+ aur B- bante hain (B zyada electronegative hai). CH3-Cl mein joray chlorine ki taraf jata hai, methyl carbocation CH3+ aur chloride ion Cl- bante hain.
blocks.caption: Heterolytic fission aur ions ka banna (Figure 11.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Homolytic aur heterolytic fission mein farq batayein (exercise Q.2b).
blocks.explanation: Homolytic fission mein mushtarka pair har tukre ko ek ek electron de kar bat-ta hai, unpaired electrons wale neutral free radicals dete hue, jaise roshni se chlorine ka tootna. Heterolytic fission mein dono electrons zyada electronegative atom ko jate hain, cation aur anion dete hue, poore khamdar teer se dikhai gai.

items: Mechanism = reaction ke qadam. Homolytic fission: bond barabar toot kar free radicals (unpaired electron, bohat reactive). Heterolytic fission: dono electrons ek atom ko, mukhalif charge wale ions (poore khamdar teer).
